label: Tournament Match Notice
description: Says in chat and on screen that the players here have a tournament match: when both players of a ready or live match are on the server, in warmup only, once per map. The site is asked in the background only when the players change; a failure just skips the notice.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns the notice on. It also needs the site URL and token.

cvars.label: Site URL
cvars.description: Base URL of the tournament site, e.g. https://frontiersgaming.com

cvars.label: Site token
cvars.description: Service token of the tournament site with the scope game:read.
